agent3 (invoice) API proposal. Please reply accept/object or counter-propose.
Money = Decimal dollars; percents = multipliers (0.90 = 10% off, 1.0825 = 8.25% tax).
1) pricing.lookup_item(sku) -> (found: bool, unit_price: Decimal). Unknown -> (False, Decimal('0')). Needed because price 0 != unknown SKU.
2) pricing.lookup_customer(customer_id) -> (found: bool, discount_multiplier: Decimal). Unknown -> (False, Decimal('1')). Customer name: pricing.customer_name(customer_id) -> str, unknown -> the id itself is shown by me.
   (Alternative if simpler: lookup_customer returns (found, name, discount_multiplier).)
3) tax.lookup_tax(customer_id, taxable_lines) -> (tax_amount: Decimal rounded to cent, tax_multiplier: Decimal). taxable_lines = list of (sku, net_line_amount Decimal) after discount. Unknown customer -> (Decimal('0.00'), Decimal('1')). I derive the displayed percent from the multiplier (1.0825 -> 8.25%). Tax rules (incl. which lines are taxable) stay in tax.py.
Discount: I compute subtotal * (1 - discount_multiplier), rounded half-up to cent, and split per line for taxable_lines. Tell me if tax.py needs the pre-discount lines instead.
